title: Irreducible shallow tanh neural networks are a manifold
abstract: arXiv:2611.30553v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks (NNs) have been increasingly used as function approximators, motivating the study of the geometry of their function spaces. We study the set of functions represented by shallow neural networks with hyperbolic tangent activation, fixed input and output dimensions, and $n$ hidden neurons. In particular, we prove that the subset represented by irreducible networks in the sense of Sussmann (Neural Networks, 1992), i.e., networks with no redundant neurons, is a smooth embedded submanifold of the Sobolev spaces $\mathrm{W}^{\ell,p}$ on bounded sets for any $\ell\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p\in[1,+\infty]$. The key step is to show that if a sequence of networks converges in $\mathrm{W}^{\ell,p}$ to an irreducible network with the same number of hidden neurons, then the parameters of the approximating networks remain bounded. Finally, we show that this manifold has exactly $n+1$ connected components when both the input and output are sca

translated_title: 不可约浅层tanh神经网络是一个流形
translated_abstract: 神经网络越来越多地被用作函数逼近器，这促使人们对其函数空间的几何结构展开研究。我们研究了具有双曲正切激活函数、固定输入输出维度以及n个隐藏神经元的浅层神经网络所表示的函数集合。特别地，我们证明了由Sussmann（Neural Networks, 1992）意义下的不可约网络（即不含冗余神经元的网络）所表示的子集，对于任意 ℓ∈ℕ 和 p∈[1,+∞]，是有界集上Sobolev空间 W^{ℓ,p} 中的光滑嵌入子流形。证明的关键步骤在于表明：若一个网络序列在 W^{ℓ,p} 中收敛到具有相同数量隐藏神经元的不可约网络，则这些逼近网络的参数保持有界。最后，我们证明当输入和输出均为标量时，该流形恰好有 n+1 个连通分支。
tldr: 本文证明了由不可约浅层tanh神经网络所表示的函数集合构成Sobolev空间中的光滑嵌入子流形，且当输入输出为标量时，该流形恰好具有n+1个连通分支。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the set of functions represented by irreducible shallow tanh neural networks forms a smooth embedded submanifold of Sobolev spaces, which has exactly n+1 connected components when both input and output are scalar.
